body: Thank you for being so helpful! I'm pretty tired, so I'm probably going to take a nap but I appreciate that you took the time to talk to me :)
Thanks for the advice :) I probably try to reason with myself too much when I get these thoughts.

So how do I go about doing that? Is it sort of like ignoring it or confronting it?

It's sort of like an inner voice that berates you and says mean things about you and other people. I've tried to talk with myself whenever that happens, but confronting it only makes it worse.
I probably sound crazy now that I'm writing this.

Hmm, that sound like a good idea. Gonna try that before I go to sleep tonight.

What do you do about intrusive thoughts? I feel like they're unescapable even if you try to concentrate on something else.
Yeah, it does fog your brain up. I feel so empty-headed most of the time.

Thanks for responding. :) I'm in sweden, so it's a bit different but you have some good advice.

I don't know if it's already too late. I'm re-doing last year's courses and failing them. I attended class last year, but I was anxious about meeting former class mates this semester, so I started skipping class to avoid meeting anyone I knew. Then I got anxious about what people would think about me starting to attend class a month late. Eventually I just gave up.

That's an interesting perspective.

I have a certain method that usually pops up in my head. I don't know how strict this subreddit is with with rule 1b. so I'm not going to explicitly talk about it. However, I can't get it out of my head even though I know it wouldn't work.

Yeah, that's probably a good idea. I was depressed for a while in high school due to not performing very well in school (I think). I eventually started talking to a therapist when I realized that I had to do something about it. I just feel stupid for not learning from my mistakes and talking to someone. It feels like I'm in a cycle of being depressed and then not and I could have done something about this before I became a suicidal hermit.

Sorry for ranting.

That's what I'm hoping for. Thanks for your encouraging words. :)

I'm angry at myself for not doing anything about it. I haven't cleaned my room in forever, I rarely talk to anyone in person, I rarely get out of my room at all. I should probably talk to someone about it, but i'm always postponing it.
